How it works

  1. Choose your visaPick from the list above, or ask us which one fits your plans.
  2. PayPay on the website, or message us for other payment methods.
  3. Send your documentsSend your required documents via WhatsApp or email. We’ll prepare your application.
  4. Receive your visaYour e-Visa or official Stay Permit letter will be sent directly to you. No passport stamping required.

title: sec center
html:
Questions clients ask

What do I need to send for a tourist visa?

A photo of your passport's main page, valid for at least 6 months, and a photo of you holding your passport. Send them by WhatsApp or email.

How long does it take?

It depends on the visa: 1–2 working days for an e-VOA and 8–10 working days for a C1 extension. Each visa above shows its time.

How do I extend my visa?

An extension needs an Indonesian sponsor and a set of application documents. If we handle it, we only need your passport and we prepare everything else.

What happens if I overstay?

Immigration charges a fine of Rp 1,000,000 for every day of overstay. After 60 days of overstay you must pay the fine and you will be deported. Message us as early as you can.

Beware of scammers. Our bank account is only under the VISA4BALI name. We do not have bank accounts under foreigners' names.
